verdict.rationale: The axis applies: INPI runs an IP open-data portal (data.inpi.fr), and the probe shows it gates access behind account-issued tokens, so API versioning and deprecation are fair questions to ask. However, nothing in the evidence documents API version numbers, a version lifecycle, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The docs cover only filing procedures (marques, brevets, dessins & modèles) and general services.
